title: Conditional-Adversarial-Learning-to-Enhance-Bot_Detection
summary: Source code for the CALEB paper, which trains conditional GAN variants (CGAN, AC-GAN) to generate synthetic social-bot account data for augmenting bot-detection classifiers. SDV's evaluation utilities (evaluate, KSTest, GMLogLikelihood) are run to score the statistical fidelity of the GAN-generated synthetic data against real data.
evidence: experimental_evaluation/synthetic_data_evaluation.py:4-6 imports sdv.evaluation.evaluate, sdv.metrics.tabular KSTest/GMLogLikelihood, used in evaluate_synthetic_data()
